fafner: It is said that Fafner became a Genie over a millennium ago after finding a Genie bottle and wishing to be as powerful as the Genie who granted the wish. The wish was granted, and he has served the leaders of Bracada ever since.
astral: Astral arrived in Erathia nearly ten years ago and was quickly accepted into Bracada's Wizards' Guild. His rapid rise through the ranks led some to joke that only magic could have brought him such success so soon.
serena: The first time Serena cast a spell, she nearly killed herself by channeling too much magical energy into it. A Wizard in a neighboring town felt the force, sought her out and brought her to the Wizards' Guild to learn control. Her remarkable power came before she knew how to contain it.
solmyr: Solmyr was trapped in a Genie bottle for over a millennium. Grateful to the human who finally released him, he accidentally swore to serve that man for eternity. As fate would have it, the man is Gavin Magnus, immortal ruler of the Bracada Highlands.
